primitives.name: Context-Adjusted EPA Residualisation
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Context-adjusted EPA residualisation (mission primitive 1) Built the residualiser the brief asks for: regress EPA on the situational basis, keep the residual as "pure" context value.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\hat{\\epsilon}': 'dimensionless residual representing pure team quality', '\\text{EPA}': 'expected points added, dimensionless', 'X_{\\text{situational}}': 'vector of situational features (down, distance, field position, score difference, quarter)'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear relationship between EPA and situational features; no opponent or personnel included in model.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When situational basis explains <2% of variance, residual becomes unreliable as a team quality proxy.

primitives.name: Residual Team Quality Ranking
primitives.verbatim_quote: HistGradientBoosting on down, distance, field position, |score diff|, quarter — no opponent, no personnel.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Q_{\\text{team}}': 'team quality rank, dimensionless', '\\hat{\\epsilon}_t': 'residual for team t'}
primitives.assumptions: Team quality is captured by residual magnitude; ranking is stable across small perturbations in features.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Rankings become unstable when R2 drops below 1.5%, indicating high noise in residual signal.

primitives.assumptions: Stability implies minimal feature noise in residual; variance is representative of true team quality.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If \sigma_{\hat{\epsilon}} exceeds 1.5, residual is too noisy for reliable inference.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core operator is a linear regression of EPA against situational variables (down, distance, field position, score differential, quarter), yielding a residual term that purports to isolate team quality from context. This residual is computed per possession team and used to rank teams. The regression's explanatory power is low (R2 ≈ 1.5%), implying that most variance in EPA is due to situational factors rather than inherent team ability. The stability of rankings across different model specifications suggests robustness to minor feature changes, but the low R2 indicates that the residual is more of a screening tool than a valuation metric. The residual's large standard deviation (σ ≈ 1.41) implies significant noise, making any claim of 'pure context' fragile. The absence of opponent and personnel controls introduces schedule bias and confounding, limiting interpretability. The sign ambiguity in EPA further restricts absolute interpretation, leaving only relative orderings valid. Thus, while the primitive enables consistent ranking, its use requires careful calibration of uncertainty bounds and explicit control for opponent and personnel effects.
